name: castle
description: A square stone castle: four curtain walls on a footing with a wall-walk behind a crenellated parapet, arrow slits and a stair up from the paved courtyard; a round corner tower at each corner with a battered base, machicolations and a flared conical slate roof; a gatehouse in the +Z face with two drum towers, a portcullis, oak gates and a lowered drawbridge that meets a stone causeway over the moat; a square keep against the back wall with corner buttresses, bartizans, a hipped roof, a flag and an outside stair; a great hall with a tiled roof and chimney; and a well.

params.name: size
params.description: Length of a side between the corner towers, in metres.

params.name: wallHeight
params.description: Height of the curtain walls in metres.
